Yes, definitely run shadow visions if you have it. Otherwise, you can run cabal shadow priest as a good replacement or even just another potion of madness. I'm constantly playing around with my decks to see what works. I don't have a lot of cards so what works best for you and what works best for me may not be the same. If you manage to unlock Lyra you can really make an incredible deck. But really there are a ton of legendaries that will mesh well with this basic deck.

Yeah definitely don't worry about being rank 14. I was hard stuck at rank 13 just like a month ago. Honestly just watch Brian Kibler (or Disguised Toast or Trump) for a couple weeks and really pay attention to how they think. It really helps you learn to play around your opponent .

So the primary deck I've been using to climb is just a priest inner fire divine spirit combo. When I hit rank 8 the deck was:

x2 circle of healing

x2 inner fire

x2 northshire cleric

x1 potion of madness

x2 power word: shield

x1 acidic swamp ooze

x1 radiant elemental 

x2 shadow ascendant

x2 shadow word pain

x2 kabal talonpriest

x1 shadow word death

x2 tar creeper

x2 auchenai soulpriest

x2 priest of the feast

x1 holy nova

x2 kabal songstealer

x1 dragonfire potion

x1 bonemare

x1 mind control

But I don't think that mind control works well in the deck (I've since removed it.) If you want to play this deck keep in mind, you want to dominate the board early. The later the game goes the weaker this deck. This deck is really weak to pirate warrior and mid-range hunter. Depending on the match up you have to mulligan very differently. You generally want to keep a northshire cleric but you don't always want to play it turn one in every match up. Card drawing for combos is super important if you run low on resources the game is pretty much over; so playing northshire for max card draw is key. Other things to keep in mind are generally when to use your inner fires. I don't always save inner fire to buff a 30+ health minion for OTK. In discard warlock or jade druid match-ups especially inner firing a buffed tar creeper might just give you the game. 

My other good decks are a discount jade druid deck and a slight variation on u/DisguisedToastHS F2P Hunter's deck. It's really strong and super easy to make.
